propositions: The AC1 contract test claims CLI, public Python, MCP, and reconciler entry points compose identical OperationSnapshots but does not drive the real MCP and reconciler surfaces—it re-invokes the shared composer with identical arguments instead, yielding a trivially true comparison that would stay green if those surfaces stopped routing through the composer

The MCP and reconciler surface blocks must drive real entry points (build_server() + call_tool and rebar_reconciler.__main__.main with argv) and capture their actual composed snapshots via module-global rebinding of compose_operation_snapshot at call time
Each surface's assertion must fail with an explicit message if its surface composes no snapshot, to prevent a silent no-op in the spy from masking a broken entry point

Each surface must anchor its composed snapshot to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys with distinct provenance) in addition to cross-surface comparison, so a perturbed composer fails rather than staying green when all surfaces move together
